key_findings: Oral glucosamine sulphate and chondroitin sulphate (alone and synergistically in combination) reduced mechanical/cold allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia after sciatic CCI in rats.
GS and CS reduced DRG levels of NGF, TNF-α, NFκB, PGE2 and IL-1β elevated by CCI; IL-6 was reduced mainly by the combination.
